sections.appearance: She has black wavy hair tied into ponytails on both sides with a pair of yellow and purple orbs connected to a band and engineering googles hanging on her forehead. She has black floppy dog ears, a black tail with a white tip, and gray eyes. Halo ==== Hibiki's halo is a small yellow barred circle surrounded by two larger circles, the outer circle being thicker. Uniform ==== She wears a white and yellow hoodie, a black and gray tank top with short pants underneath, webbed stockings and black boots with a Millennium logo on the rim and soleprint. She also carries two handcarries, a schoolbag with a sling for her tools and an oversized crate for her mortar shells. Firearm ==== thumb|Fancy Light|150px She uses a silver LRM vz. 99 ANTOS commando mortar with a black baseplate, carry strap, and handle. The muzzle cover appears to be made of cork as opposed to polymer. The Millennium emblem is imprinted on the barrel base and the mortar sights. She also carries around a black box containing four mortar shells.

sections.personality: Although she is rather introverted, she is quite dedicated with engineering and inventing, similar to the other Engineering Department members. Her passion leads to numerous unusual inventions. She likes also making cosplay outfits as her hobby, one being her cheerleader costume which was made during her first days of making cosplay outfits when she was younger.
